ss-delta 0.5.3 is a hotfix for Android: since 0.5.0, the app's setup stopped while building the game on the device. Nothing else changes; on a PC, 0.5.2 and 0.5.3 are the same.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.5.3-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.5.3-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.5.3-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.5.3-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony (about 180 MB; the compiler is in the download), and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. From then on the program goes straight to the game. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## Fixed

* **Android: building the game on the device stopped at "Recompiling eboot"** since 0.5.0 (`FileNotFoundError: ... overrides/eboot.json`): the APK didn't carry the game's code fixes (the 60 fps fixes of [#14](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/14) and the loading screens), which the build needs. Install the 0.5.3 APK over the old one and build again from the setup screen. Building from a PC (`--android`) wasn't affected.

## Upgrading from 0.5.x

Android: install the APK over the old one; the setup builds the game again (your dump isn't needed if the game is already installed in the app). PC: nothing to do, 0.5.2 is the same; unpacking 0.5.3 over it is fine, saves and settings are kept. Coming from 0.4.x, build again with `--install` (see the [0.5.0 notes](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/releases/tag/v0.5.0)).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
